svg.text: All sockets shown; only a subset spawns.
600 Gold total, chosen in rotational pairs.
Four fixed resource sites, one at each hub.
Supply Posts pay +6 Gold/s when active.
Home HQ pays +2 Gold/s. No tree mining.
Central road: 290 m rally to rally
All corridors reserve 16 m clear width.
Homes connect before either camp clears.
Trees are scenery; Gold is the only resource.
Source: Config/RTS/pinewatch_vale.json • Authored layout, not a live level capture or navigation measurement.
